responsibility: Implements the public Arm Custom Datapath Extension intrinsic header. It maps ACLE CDE function-like APIs to the underlying Arm backend builtins for scalar core-register, VFP/MVE-register, and MVE-vector forms, including predicated MVE variants, and conditionally exposes those interfaces based on __ARM_FEATURE_CDE, __ARM_FP, and __ARM_FEATURE_MVE.
